summary: Frontend E2E for iteration_828 RealAICoach session validated against production preview URL (bird-game-preview-7.preview.emergentagent.com). Login flow, Home Nova widget (all six sub-flows: FAB open, compact panel with latest-reply/context/prompt-0/open-conversation, expand->chat, collapse->compact, expanded close-button, compact close-button), Blog Editorial admin panel (new draft -> submit_review -> approve_publish AND separate schedule flow with ISO date + confirm), Job Search Find Jobs alerts save+delete, and Flappy Bird regression all PASSED. Command Palette opens with Ctrl+K and filters correctly to 'Leaderboard' item, but clicking the leaderboard item closes the palette WITHOUT actually navigating to /leaderboard and WITHOUT posting the /api/home/command-palette-nav telemetry — URL stayed at /. Direct navigation to /leaderboard returns 200 and backend POST endpoint returns 401 (auth needed) confirming both exist; the bug is client-side in CommandPalette.handleSelect (line ~113 of /app/frontend/src/components/nav/CommandPalette.tsx).

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking a palette destination (e.g. command-palette-item-leaderboard) fires onClose() but neither router.push(dest.href) navigation nor api.post('/home/command-palette-nav') runs. Palette closes and URL remains '/'. Both /leaderboard route and /api/home/command-palette-nav endpoint exist (200/401), so the regression is in handleSelect. Suspect: onClose() unmounts the palette (component returns null when !visible at line 137) before the queued router.push and api.post microtasks execute in RN-Web pressable path, or the api client base URL/interceptor swallows the request without emitting network. Recommend calling router.push and api.post BEFORE onClose(), or dispatch them via setTimeout(0) to escape the current React commit.

rca of the issue: CommandPalette handleSelect (line 113 /app/frontend/src/components/nav/CommandPalette.tsx) sequences: writeRecent -> api.post (fire-and-forget) -> onClose() -> router.push. onClose() flips 'visible' state; the return-null guard at line 137 (`if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || !visible) return null;`) unmounts the palette immediately. React may batch the unmount before router.push executes and browser scheduling may abort the fetch microtask. Observed net effect: palette closes cleanly but no network POST and no route change. Mitigation: put router.push(dest.href) FIRST (or immediately after telemetry), and delay onClose via `requestAnimationFrame` / `setTimeout(onClose, 0)` so the current tick completes both api.post initiation and router.push before unmount. Alternative: use `router.push` from a stable parent and only close on route-change subscription.
